title: Apple Intelligence vs Google Gemini: which AI ecosystem wins?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Apple Intelligence leads with end-to-end encryption and secure enclaves — privacy is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Gemini's multi-modal capabilities and open API access let developers innovate without Apple's walled garden.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Apple's M-series chips and Neural Engine deliver unmatched on-device performance — no cloud dependency.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Gemini scales across devices and platforms, integrating seamlessly into Android, web, and enterprise workflows.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Gemini’s open-source foundation and cross-platform flexibility make it the future of AI ecosystems.
